memory_update.text: MP is the reference anchor for US-listed rare-earth magnet independence because it has explicit DoD equity, price-floor, offtake, heavy rare-earth separation, and Texas magnet-manufacturing evidence.
USAR should be tracked as an underfollowed direct magnet-manufacturing candidate after Stillwater Phase 1A commissioning and 2026 commercial magnet production claims.
UUUU is a key upstream oxide/separation candidate because Dy and Tb are heavy rare-earth bottleneck inputs for high-performance magnets, but it is not a finished-magnet producer.

AREC/ReElement is a speculative micro-cap circular-supply candidate; survival into later layers requires hard evidence of commercial-scale REE separation revenue, customer qualification, and financing/listing stability.

node: Heavy rare-earth magnets, processing, and defense-qualified magnet supply
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around non-China rare-earth magnet resilience. The reference lane is MP Materials because it has the clearest public-market link to US mine-to-magnet capacity and explicit US government support. The underfollowed lane points to companies one step upstream or downstream of finished magnets: USAR for integrated magnet manufacturing and alloy/metal capability, Energy Fuels for separated light/heavy rare-earth oxides including Dy/Tb inputs, and American Resources/ReElement as a speculative micro-cap circular supply-chain and separation candidate. These are research candidates only, not buy/sell recommendations.
